title: Page 10
content_zh:
一晃眼三日过去了，童悠悠白日里不是陪着徐大娘说话，就是带着莲姐儿玩耍，她琴棋书画样样精通，绣活也极好，惹得莲姐儿崇拜至极，嚷着什么都要学，倒是让徐夫人越发舍不得这个侄女了。
待徐夫人习惯了喝药，晚上热水泡脚泡澡，童悠悠就提出回童家之事。
晚饭时，徐庭便应了下来，“明日下午我早些回来，到时候亲自送你回去。”
徐大娘不放心，“我也跟去看看。”
徐夫人笑道：“那我也一起去，若是有谁欺负了悠悠，我可不让。”
这般，送童悠悠回童家的阵容也就越发庞大。
童悠悠本以为夜里梁浩海会来，结果却是悄无声息。
莲姐儿缠着新姊姊大半日，每次说起新姊姊要回家就泪眼汪汪，惹得徐大娘笑到不行，徐夫人却觉得对不住女儿，毕竟家里平日就她一个女孩子，她娘家离得远，连个表兄妹都不能常走动，以至于孩子太孤单了。
当然也是童悠悠这个侄女太惹人喜爱了，难怪莲姐儿这么黏人。
许是常年侍奉祖母养成的脾气，童悠悠温柔又和气，不论同谁在一起都能相谈甚欢，而且言之有物，见识广博。
就这么几日的功夫，她不但给徐夫人这个婶子治病，还给徐大娘和莲姐儿，甚至是徐庭都诊了脉，写了药膳方子，甚至亲自下厨教授厨娘做法。
针线也是不离手，徐大娘得了一双鞋，徐夫人和莲姐儿则是一对精致的荷包，徐庭则得了一个扇子坠儿，作为徐家收留这么几日的谢礼。
东西不能说值钱，却极为用心，让人见了就忍不住欢喜，也更怜惜她小小年纪就如此周到。毕竟懂事的孩子就是因为没人疼啊，有人娇宠的孩子才有资格刁蛮任性。
下午时，徐庭特意请了一个时辰的假，从衙门早早回来，然后亲自陪着徐大娘和徐夫人，送童悠悠回童家。
正值五月末，是一年中最好的时节，街上行人很多，商贩叫卖，很是热闹。
童悠悠却是无心好奇，即使心里如明镜一般，童家不见得欢迎她这个嫡女归来，但是对于没见过面的生身父亲，她免不得多了几分期待。
童家住的不是京都中心，三进的院子坐落在偏东的城区，门前两个小厮懒洋洋的说着闲话，不时望着行人说笑几句，瞧着有些没规矩。
徐家的两辆马车停在门前，徐管家亲自上前叫门。“两位小兄弟，劳烦通传一下，我们家老爷是御史徐庭徐大人，今日伺奉我们府里大夫人上门，送贵府嫡小姐回府。”
说着话，他就递上了徐庭的名帖。
那小厮不知是没听清，还是平日耍横惯了，根本不接名帖，一手挖着耳朵，极轻蔑的道：“你说什么？哪位要拜访我们老爷？这个，我今日忙得很，茶水没喝一口，喉咙有些干啊。”

这是索要赏钱？
徐管家皱眉，心里有些恼，但还是忍耐着从袖子里掏了一把铜钱塞了过去。“小哥拿去喝茶。”
小厮麻利的收了铜钱，这次接了名帖，他也不识字，名帖倒着拿起，一边翻动一边问道：“你方才说什么？”
徐管家忍了又忍，说道：“我们老爷、夫人和大夫人，亲自送贵府住在台州的嫡小姐回府。”
不想，小厮听了这话，如烫手一般直接把名帖扔回了徐管家怀里，嚷着撵人，“青天白日的，说什么鬼话！台州府那位小姐早就死了，被山贼抢去糟蹋之后又杀了，家里衣冠冢都立下了，怎么可能回来？诈尸啊！真是晦气，赶紧滚！”
徐管家彻底黑了脸色，收了名帖，骂道：“狗奴才，给谁脸色看！我们老爷是四品，你们老爷不过是五品，见到我们老爷也是要行礼的，你一个奴才竟敢在这里大放厥词，也不怕打烂你的屁股！让你通报就通报，否则没了半条小命，你别后悔！”
小厮被骂得有些懵了，到底有些胆怯，道：“我们老爷不在家，我们夫人在后宅。但是台州的那位小姐确实死了，我们前日还奉命去坟头烧了纸呢！”
第十一章 不像主母像小妾(2)
这时候，车里等候的徐庭却是不高兴了。
童家门前的路不算宽，马车就停在石阶下，他从头到尾听得清清楚楚。
原本他听梁浩海说起童家继夫人指使管家收买山贼奸杀童悠悠，他还有几分不相信。在一个男人看来，女人是杀鸡都害怕的柔弱之辈，怎么可能做出这么狠毒之事，特别是他们徐家后宅安宁，从来没发生过这些。
但这会儿，他完全肯定童家背后有猫腻。因为那位二管家和山贼已经死了，两个婆子被锁拿在台州附近，童家是从哪里得到消息说童悠悠死了？难道是台州附近的府衙发现凶案？那是如何确定死者是童悠悠，又是怎么这么迅速通报到京都的？
他越想越生气，直接掀开窗帘吩咐，“管家，派人去礼部衙门请童老爷回来一趟！”
“是，老爷！”
有主子撑腰，徐管家的脊背立刻挺直了三分，扭身下了台阶，吩咐一个跟车小厮拿了名帖就奔去礼部衙门。
童家看门的两个小厮见状才知道害怕，心知他们许是闯祸了。于是，一个守大门，一个立刻往后宅跑去。
不过半刻钟，童家大门被形高挑偏瘦，配上尖脸杏眼柳叶眉，略显苍白的脸色，就怎么瞧着，都有种病弱之美，彷佛一句高声嚷嚷都能把她吓哭，一阵大风便能把她吹走一般。
但徐庭，还有透过车窗看出来的徐大娘、徐夫人和童悠悠，皆微微皱眉。
因为无论是从过世的童老夫人那里说起，还是从小厮嘴里横死的童悠悠这里算，童家算是家有丧事，但这位童夫人头上却戴了金钗，衣衫也算不上素色，可谓是明面上的礼数都没做全。
童夫人扫了一眼徐家的马车，眼见车上的标记，就狠狠回身瞪了一眼门房小厮。末了她赶紧下了台阶，说道：“是王姊姊来了吗？下人不知礼数，怠慢王姊姊了，还请进屋奉茶，小妹给姊姊赔罪。”

徐夫人娘家姓王，平日在各家走动，同童夫人见过几面，这才有这会儿的姊妹相称。
徐夫人掀开窗帘，温和道：“童夫人客气了，我这次是伺奉大嫂，随同老爷一起来送贵府的嫡小姐回府的。童老爷不在家，方才贵府小厮又说嫡小姐早就过世了，我们倒是不好冒然进府。不如请童夫人稍等片刻，童老爷回来，我们分说清楚才好进门，否则给府里惹了麻烦，我们心里也过意不去。”
童夫人目光像钩子一般往马车里望去，可惜徐夫人把窗子堵得严严实实，她什么也看不到。
她只能红了眼，帕子拭着眼角，哽咽道：“姊姊这说的是什么话，我们府里大小姐实在可怜，一直养在台州的婆母身边，婆母过世，大小姐许是孤单，心急回京都，结果半路上遭了难，家里刚刚立了衣冠冢，这是怎么说的？难道大小姐没死，这苦命的孩子……”
有路人经过，聚在不远处听热闹，左邻右舍的小厮婆子也凑在一起议论——
“这童家又是怎么了？前几日老家的老夫人过世，跟着大姑娘也死了，如今怎么被堵了门呢？”
“听说是大小姐没死，被送回来了。”
content_en:
Three days passed in a blink of an eye. During the day, Tong Youyou was either talking to Aunt Xu or playing with Sister Lian. She was proficient in music, chess, calligraphy and painting, and was also very good at embroidery. Sister Lian admired her so much that she wanted to learn everything, which made Mrs. Xu even more reluctant to let go of her niece.
After Mrs. Xu got used to taking medicine and soaking her feet in hot water at night, Tong Youyou proposed returning to Tong's house.
During dinner, Xu Ting agreed, "I will come back early tomorrow afternoon and take you back in person."
Aunt Xu was worried, "I'll go and have a look too."
Mrs. Xu smiled and said, "Then I'll go too. If anyone bullies Youyou, I won't let you."
In this way, the lineup to send Tong Youyou back to Tong's home became larger and larger.
Tong Youyou thought Liang Haohai would come at night, but it turned out to be silent.
Sister Lian pestered her new sister for a long time, and her eyes welled up every time she mentioned that her new sister was coming home, which made Aunt Xu laugh so much that Mrs. Xu felt sorry for her daughter. After all, she was the only girl in the family. Her natal family was far away, and even her cousins ​​could not move around often, so the child was too lonely.
Of course, Tong Youyou is such a cute niece. No wonder Sister Lian is so clingy.
Perhaps it was a temper he developed from serving his grandmother all year round. Tong Youyou is gentle and kind. No matter who he is with, he can talk happily, and his words are meaningful and knowledgeable.
In just a few days, she not only treated Mrs. Xu, her aunt, but also diagnosed the pulse of Aunt Xu, Sister Lian, and even Xu Ting, wrote medicinal recipes, and even cooked in person to teach the cook how to cook.
Needle and thread were also kept in hand. Aunt Xu got a pair of shoes, Mrs. Xu and Sister Lian got a pair of exquisite purses, and Xu Ting got a fan pendant as a thank-you gift for the Xu family for taking them in for so many days.
The things cannot be said to be valuable, but they are extremely thoughtful. People can't help but feel happy when they see them, and they pity her even more for being so considerate at such a young age. After all, sensible children are just because no one loves them. Only children who are pampered can be unruly and willful.
In the afternoon, Xu Ting took an hour's leave and came back early from the Yamen. Then he personally accompanied Aunt Xu and Mrs. Xu to send Tong Youyou back to Tong's home.
It's the end of May, which is the best time of the year. There are many people on the street and vendors are selling, which is very lively.
Tong Youyou had no intention of being curious. Even though she felt like a mirror in her heart, the Tong family might not necessarily welcome her, their legitimate daughter, back, but she could not help but have more expectations for her biological father, whom she had never met.
The Tong family did not live in the center of Kyoto. Sanjin's courtyard was located in the eastern part of the city. The two boys in front of the door chatted lazily and looked at the passers-by from time to time, joking and looking a little unruly.
Two carriages belonging to the Xu family stopped in front of the door, and Butler Xu went up to call the door in person. "Two little brothers, please tell me that our master is Mr. Xu Tingxu, the imperial censor. Today, the eldest lady of our mansion will come to see your daughter back home."
As he spoke, he handed over Xu Ting's name card.
The boy didn't know whether he didn't hear clearly or he was used to being arrogant. He didn't accept the name call at all. He dug his ears with one hand and said with great disdain: "What did you say? Who wants to visit our master? Well, I am very busy today. I didn't take a sip of the tea. My throat is a little dry."
Is this asking for a reward?
Butler Xu frowned and felt a little annoyed, but he still endured and took out a handful of copper coins from his sleeve and stuffed it in. "Brother, take it for tea."
The boy quickly collected the copper coins, and this time he received the name card. He was also illiterate. He picked up the name card upside down, turned it over and asked, "What did you just say?"
Butler Xu endured it again and again, and said: "We, sir, madam and eldest madam, will personally send your eldest daughter who lives in Taizhou back to your home."
I didn't want to, after hearing this, the boy threw the name card back into Butler Xu's arms as if it was hot, and shouted to chase him away, "What nonsense are you talking about in the clear sky! The lady in Taizhou Prefecture has died long ago, and was snatched away by bandits."He was killed after Ta, and a tomb was erected at home. How could he come back? What a charlatan! What bad luck, get out of here! "
Butler Xu's face turned completely dark, he took the name card and cursed: "You little slave, who are you showing your face to! Our master is the fourth grade, and your master is only the fifth grade. You must bow when you see our master. You, a slave, dare to talk nonsense here, and I am not afraid of having your ass smashed! Report it as you are told, otherwise half your life will be lost. Don’t regret it! "
The boy was a little confused after being scolded, and he was a little timid after all, and said: "Our master is not at home, and our wife is in the back house. But the lady from Taizhou is indeed dead, and we were ordered to burn paper at the grave the day before yesterday! "
Chapter 11: Not like a mistress, like a concubine (2)
At this time, Xu Ting, who was waiting in the car, was unhappy.
The road in front of Tong's house was not wide, and the carriage stopped at the foot of the stone steps. He could hear clearly from beginning to end.
Originally, when he heard Liang Haohai talk about the Tong family's step-wife instructing the housekeeper to bribe bandits to rape and kill Tong Youyou, he still didn't believe it. In the eyes of a man, women are weak people who are afraid of killing chickens. How could they do such a cruel thing, especially in the tranquility of their Xu family's back house, which has never happened before.
But at this moment, he was completely sure that there was something fishy behind the Tong family. Because the second housekeeper and the bandit were dead, and the two women were locked up near Taizhou. Where did the Tong family get the news that Tong Youyou was dead? Could it be that a murder case was discovered in a government office near Taizhou? How was it determined that the deceased was Tong Youyou, and how was it reported to Kyoto so quickly?
The more he thought about it, the angrier he became, so he opened the curtains and ordered, "Butler, send someone to the Rites Yamen to ask Mr. Tong to come back! "
"Yes, sir! "
With the support of his master, Butler Xu straightened his back immediately, turned and walked down the steps, and ordered a boy who was following him to take the name card and rush to the Rites Yamen.
The two young men who were guarding the Tong family realized they were scared when they saw this, knowing that they might have gotten into trouble. So, one guarded the door and the other immediately ran to the back house.
Within half an hour, Tong's door was tall and thin, with a pointed face, almond-shaped eyes and willow-leaf eyebrows, and a slightly pale complexion. No matter how he looked at it, he had a sickly beauty, as if a loud shout could scare her into tears, and a strong wind could blow her away.
But Xu Ting, as well as Aunt Xu, Mrs. Xu and Tong Youyou who were seen through the car window, all frowned slightly.
Because whether it is from the deceased Mrs. Tong, or from the story of Tong Youyou, who was killed by a young boy, the Tong family has a funeral, but this Mrs. Tong wears a gold hairpin on her head, and her clothes are not plain. It can be said that she has not done all the etiquette on the surface.
Mrs. Tong glanced at the Xu family's carriage, and when she saw the mark on the carriage, she turned around and glared at the porter. Finally, she hurried down the steps and said, "Is it Sister Wang here? The servant didn't know the etiquette and neglected Sister Wang, so he invited her into the room to serve tea, and the younger sister apologized to her elder sister. "
Mrs. Xu's maiden name is Wang. She walks around in various houses on weekdays and has met Mrs. Tong several times, so they are now considered sisters.
Mrs. Xu opened the curtains and said gently: "Mrs. Tong, you're welcome. This time I am serving the sister-in-law and accompanying the master to send the daughter-in-law of your house back to your house. Mr. Tong is not at home, and just now the servant in your mansion said that your eldest daughter has passed away a long time ago, so it is not good for us to enter the mansion rashly. Why don't you ask Mrs. Tong to wait for a while? When Master Tong comes back, we can explain clearly before entering. Otherwise, we will cause trouble to the government and we will feel bad about it. "
Mrs. Tong looked into the carriage like a hook, but unfortunately Mrs. Xu blocked the window tightly and she could not see anything.
She could only blush, wipe the corners of her eyes with her handkerchief, and choked up: "What are you talking about, sister? The eldest lady in our mansion is really pitiful. She has been raised by her mother-in-law in Taizhou. Her mother-in-law passed away. The eldest lady may be lonely and anxious to return to Kyoto. As a result, something happened on the way. The family justA tomb has just been erected. What do you mean? Could it be that the eldest lady is not dead, this poor child..."
Passers-by passed by and gathered not far away to listen to the excitement, and the young men and women from the neighbors also gathered together to discuss——
"What happened to the Tong family? The old lady in my hometown passed away a few days ago, and the eldest daughter also died. Why is the door blocked now? "
“I heard that the eldest lady survived and was sent back. "
